title: Redfin Scraper
description: Scrape Redfin homes for sale, sold homes and rentals by location or search link.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: US cities, ZIP codes, counties, neighborhoods or states, one per line, as you would type them into the Redfin search box: Austin, TX, 78701, Travis County, TX, Brooklyn, NY. Add the state to get the right city.

searchUrls.title: Redfin search links
searchUrls.description: Links of searches made on redfin.com, with any filters you set there, such as https://www.redfin.com/city/30818/TX/Austin/filter/property-type=house,min-beds=3. Rental searches (/apartments-for-rent) and sold searches work too. Each link keeps its own filters and listing type.

searchType.title: Listings
searchType.description: What to scrape for the locations. Search links keep their own listing type.

soldWithinDays.title: Sold within
soldWithinDays.description: For sold homes: how far back the sales go.

includePending.title: Include pending and under contract
includePending.description: For homes for sale: also get homes that are pending or under contract. By default only active and coming soon homes are included, as on Redfin.

propertyTypes.title: Property types
propertyTypes.sectionDescription: The same filters as on redfin.com. They apply to the locations and are added to the filters of search links.
propertyTypes.description: Leave empty for all types. For rent, multi-family means apartments, and land, manufactured, co-op and other do not apply.

minPrice.title: Minimum price
minPrice.description: In US dollars. For rentals, the monthly rent.

maxPrice.title: Maximum price
maxPrice.description: In US dollars. For rentals, the monthly rent.

minBeds.title: Minimum bedrooms
minBeds.description: Homes with at least this many bedrooms.

maxBeds.title: Maximum bedrooms
maxBeds.description: Homes with at most this many bedrooms.

minBaths.title: Minimum bathrooms
minBaths.description: Homes with at least this many bathrooms.

minSqft.title: Minimum square feet
minSqft.description: Living area of at least this many square feet.

maxSqft.title: Maximum square feet
maxSqft.description: Living area of at most this many square feet.

minYearBuilt.title: Built in or after
minYearBuilt.description: Homes built in this year or later.

maxYearBuilt.title: Built in or before
maxYearBuilt.description: Homes built in this year or earlier.

maxHoa.title: Maximum HOA fee per month
maxHoa.description: In US dollars. 0 means homes without an HOA fee. Leave empty for any.

maxDaysOnMarket.title: Listed within
maxDaysOnMarket.description: For homes for sale: only homes listed within this time, for example new listings of the last day.

keywords.title: Keywords in the description
keywords.description: Only homes whose listing description contains these words, such as pool or guest house.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: Order of the results, as on Redfin. Very large searches are read by price range, and the order applies within each range.

onlyNew.title: Only new listings since the last run
onlyNew.description: Save only listings that earlier runs of the same saved task did not save. The first run saves all current listings. Use it with a schedule to get new listings every day.

includeAllPhotos.title: Include all photo links
includeAllPhotos.description: Add the links of all photos of each home in photos. The main photo is always in photoUrl.

maxItems.title: Maximum listings in total
maxItems.description: Stop after saving this many listings. Leave empty or 0 for no limit. The example is kept small so the first run takes seconds.

maxItemsPerSearch.title: Maximum listings per search
maxItemsPerSearch.description: Limit for each location or search link, so that every search gets a share. Leave empty or 0 for no limit.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: The Actor connects directly, which is fastest. If Redfin starts limiting requests, it switches to Apify Proxy automatically. Turn on a proxy here only to use it from the start.
